		protected override void OnUpdateData()
		{
			((MMTabPageViewModel)this).OnUpdateData();
			UpdateColumnSet();
		}

		protected override void OnSubPropertyDataChanged(CxvPropertyDeclaration pd, string subPropertyName)
		{
			if (pd.Name == "Advcob_view" && subPropertyName == "Value")
			{
				UpdateColumnSet();
			}
			((CxvViewModel)this).OnSubPropertyDataChanged(pd, subPropertyName);
		}

		private class DisplayedFrameConverter : IMultiValueConverter
		{
			public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				if (values != null && values.Length == 3)
				{
					bool? flag = values[0] as bool?;
					bool? flag2 = values[1] as bool?;
					bool? flag3 = values[2] as bool?;
					if (flag == true && flag2 != true && flag3 != true)
					{
						return "MMFrame1";
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		{

		}

	[ProgId("MMPipeline.MMPipeline_Result_Profil")]
	public class MMPipeline_Result_Profil : MMTabPage, IComponentConnector
	{
		private class DisplayedFrameConverter : IMultiValueConverter
		{
			public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				if (values != null && values.Length == 3)
				{
					bool? flag = values[0] as bool?;
					bool? flag2 = values[1] as bool?;
					bool? flag3 = values[2] as bool?;
					if (flag == true && flag2 != true && flag3 != true)
					{
						return "fraProfile";
					}
					if (flag != true && flag2 == true && flag3 != true)
					{
						return "DenseProfile";
					}
					if (flag != true && flag2 != true && flag3 == true)
					{
						return "DiluteProfile";
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
			{
				throw new NotImplementedException();
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty DisplayedFrameProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DisplayedFrame", typeof(string), typeof(MMPipeline_Result_Profil), new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(OnDisplayedFramePropertyChanged));

		internal Grid grdTopMost;

		internal MMLabel advcboView_label;

		internal MMComboEdit advcboView;

		internal MMGroupBox fraProfile;

		internal MMScrollAreaMS grdProfile;

		internal MMGroupBox DenseProfile;

		internal MMScrollAreaMS grdProfile2;

		internal MMGroupBox DiluteProfile;

		internal MMScrollAreaMS grdProfile3;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		public string DisplayedFrame
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)((DependencyObject)this).GetValue(DisplayedFrameProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				((DependencyObject)this).SetValue(DisplayedFrameProperty, (object)value);
			}
		}

		public MMPipeline_Result_Profil()
		{
			((MMViewModelContainer)this).ViewModelType = typeof(MMPipeline_Result_Profil_ViewModel);
			InitializeComponent();
		}

		protected override void OnInitialized(EventArgs e)
		{
			((FrameworkElement)this).SetBinding(DisplayedFrameProperty, (BindingBase)new MultiBinding
			{
				Bindings = 
				{
					(BindingBase)new Binding("FluidProfile_state.IsVisible"),
					(BindingBase)new Binding("DenseProfile_state.IsVisible"),
					(BindingBase)new Binding("DiluteProfile_state.IsVisible")
				},
				Converter = new DisplayedFrameConverter(),
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay
			});
			((FrameworkElement)this).OnInitialized(e);
		}

		private void OnDisplayedFrameChanged(string oldValue, string newValue)
		{
			if (string.Equals(DisplayedFrame, "fraProfile", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				((MMTabPage)this).SupressScrollViewerInTempalte = true;
				((MMTabPage)this).ZoomElementName = "grdProfile";
				grdTopMost.RowDefinitions[0].Height = new GridLength(10.0, GridUnitType.Auto);
				grdTopMost.RowDefinitions[1].Height = new GridLength(10.0, GridUnitType.Star);
			}
			else if (string.Equals(DisplayedFrame, "DenseProfile", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				((MMTabPage)this).SupressScrollViewerInTempalte = true;
				((MMTabPage)this).ZoomElementName = "grdProfile2";
				grdTopMost.RowDefinitions[0].Height = new GridLength(10.0, GridUnitType.Star);
				grdTopMost.RowDefinitions[1].Height = new GridLength(10.0, GridUnitType.Auto);
			}
			else if (string.Equals(DisplayedFrame, "DiluteProfile", StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				((MMTabPage)this).SupressScrollViewerInTempalte = true;
				((MMTabPage)this).ZoomElementName = "grdProfile3";
				grdTopMost.RowDefinitions[0].Height = new GridLength(10.0, GridUnitType.Star);
				grdTopMost.RowDefinitions[1].Height = new GridLength(10.0, GridUnitType.Auto);
			}
			else
			{
				((MMTabPage)this).SupressScrollViewerInTempalte = false;
				((MMTabPage)this).ZoomElementName = null;
				grdTopMost.RowDefinitions[0].Height = new GridLength(10.0, GridUnitType.Auto);
				grdTopMost.RowDefinitions[1].Height = new GridLength(10.0, GridUnitType.Auto);
			}
		}

		private static void OnDisplayedFramePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			(d as MMPipeline_Result_Profil).OnDisplayedFrameChanged((string)e.OldValue, (string)e.NewValue);
		}

		private IEnumerable<string> GetSelectedIds()
		{
			IList gridData = grdSegment_Summary_GridData as IList;
			foreach (int selectedRowIndex in SelectedRowIndexes)
			{
				grdSegment_Summary_GridData_ItemTemplate grdSegment_Summary_GridData_ItemTemplate = gridData[selectedRowIndex] as grdSegment_Summary_GridData_ItemTemplate;
				yield return grdSegment_Summary_GridData_ItemTemplate.GetId();
			}
		}

		private void SpawnSegData(int sgno)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DisplayFormEventArgs e = new DisplayFormEventArgs();
			string text = "";
			try
			{
				text = CxsConverter.ValueToString(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.PIPE_METH", "value"));
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (text == "SOLIDS")
			{
				e.FormType = typeof(MMPipeline_Dialog_Edit2);
			}
			else
			{
				e.FormType = typeof(MMPipeline_Dialog_Edit);
			}
			e.HelpId = 149;
			e.HelpFile = "Pipeline.hlp";
			e.DisplayMode = (DisplayFormMode)0;
			e.ShowPrompts = true;
			e.ShortName = Resources.MMPipeline_Setup_Connec_ViewModel_Segment_Data;
			e.Parameters.Add("SEGN", sgno);
			e.CompleteDataPaths = new string[3] { "CON1", "SEG1", "EXSEGNODE" };
			((MMViewModel)this).DisplayForm(e);
		}

		private void cmdDelete_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			IOrderedEnumerable<int> orderedEnumerable = _SelectedRowIndexes.OrderBy((int index) => index);
			IEnumerable<string> enumerable = from index in _SelectedRowIndexes
				orderby index
				select (index + 1).ToString();
			((MMViewModel)this).DeleteChildren("@main.Input.INNODE", (IEnumerable<int>)orderedEnumerable, enumerable, false);
			string[] array = CxsConverter.ValueToStringArray(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.INNODE", "child_ids"));
			if (array == null || array.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num = 1; num <= array.Length; num++)
			{
				if (array[num - 1] != num.ToString())
				{
					((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.INNODE." + array[num - 1], "id", (object)num.ToString());
				}
			}
		}

		private bool cmdDelete_CommandCanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (SelectedRowIndexes != null)
			{
				return SelectedRowIndexes.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void cmdEdit_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			int sgno = _SelectedRowIndexes[0] + 1;
			SpawnSegData(sgno);
		}

		private bool cmdEdit_CommandCanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (SelectedRowIndexes != null)
			{
				return SelectedRowIndexes.Count == 1;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void cmdNew_CommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			int? num = CxsConverter.ValueToInt32(((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndGet("@main.Input.INNODE", "child_count"));
			int num2 = 0;
			if (num.HasValue)
			{
				num2 = num.Value;
			}
			string text = "@main.Input.INNODE";
			((MMViewModel)this).AddChild(text, num2);
			((CxvViewModel)this).ExpandDataPathAndSet("@main.Input.INNODE.#" + num2, "id", (object)(num2 + 1));
			SpawnSegData(num2 + 1);
		}

		private void grid_RowDoubleClickCommandExecute(object parameter)
		{
			IEnumerator<string> enumerator = GetSelectedIds().GetEnumerator();
			if (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SpawnSegData(int.Parse(enumerator.Current));
			}
		}
	}
